summary: Emergent Google Sign-in integration tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed covering POST /api/auth/session (invalid session_id -> 401 with correct Indonesian detail, missing body -> 422), legacy JWT login still works, PATCH /users/{id} google_email with uniqueness (self OK, cross-user duplicate -> 409), GET /auth/me includes google_email, POST /users google_email uniqueness (create OK -> 200, duplicate -> 409, cleanup DELETE succeeds), dual-token get_current_user via seeded emg_ session_token (valid works, expired -> 401 'Session expired', logout revokes -> subsequent /me -> 401), and JWT stateless logout confirmed (JWT still valid after /auth/logout as expected). Frontend: /login renders the 'Masuk dengan Google' button (testID=login-google-button); classic username/password login with superadmin/super123 navigates to /(superadmin)/dashboard successfully.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:182-185 (logoBadge uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). RN Web reports these as deprecated in favour of the unified boxShadow style.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated when convenient (likely from a third-party wrapper such as SafeAreaView or Toast).

Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Expected on web preview; safe to ignore for now, but if a native driver is needed on iOS/Android it must be tested on a real device build.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' in login.tsx logoBadge and audit other screens for the same pattern.
(Optional) Audit codebase for props.pointerEvents usage and move it into style.pointerEvents to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:439-511 (POST /auth/session) correctly uses upsert-free insert; a repeat sign-in will insert a NEW session_token row on each call — this is fine because the endpoint mints a fresh token per exchange, but if a session_id is retried the frontend must guard against double-processing (already handled via the in-memory used-session-id Set in googleAuth.ts).
server.py:278-304 (get_current_user) properly compares tz-aware expiry (defensive `if exp.tzinfo is None` block) — verified functional through the expired-session test path.
server.py:602-608 (PATCH /users update google_email) allows clearing via empty string ('') — verified: PATCH with google_email:'' clears the field to null (tested in TestFinalCleanup).
server.py file is ~1870 lines. Consider splitting into modules (auth, users, transactions, reports) — outside scope of this test cycle.
seed_data_creation: Test transiently inserted 2 rows into user_sessions (valid + expired) for the superadmin user and one temporary sales user (ga_test_*) — all rows explicitly deleted at end of the run. google_email set on superadmin during PATCH tests is also cleared in TestFinalCleanup, so the DB is left in its original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Sign-in integration is fully green on the backend + light frontend smoke. Real end-to-end OAuth via auth.emergentagent.com cannot be automated in the preview (would require a live Google account). Any future tests should reuse /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth.py which is idempotent and cleans up after itself. Base URL is picked from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Mongo direct access uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env for the emg_ token seed test.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs discovered; feature works as designed.
